<function=python>

print(f"Purple objects: {len(purple_nodes)}")
for pn in purple_nodes:
    print(f"  pixels={pn['pixels']}, boundary={pn['boundary']}")

# Check full board layout - look at left side where character is

print("\n--- Left side (rows 35-45, cols 10-25) ---")

result = action(['RIGHT'])
seg = current_frame.segmentation
char = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b' and n['pixels'] <= 10][0]
print(f"\nAfter RIGHT: character at {char['boundary']}")

# Try ACTION7
result = action(['ACTION7'])
seg = current_frame.segmentation
char = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b' and n['pixels'] <= 10][0]
print(f"After ACTION7: character at {char['boundary']}")

# Check green blocks
green_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N' and n['pixels'] > 5]
print(f"Green blocks: {len(green_nodes)}")
for gn in green_nodes:
    b = gn['boundary']
    center_r = sum(p[0] for p in b) // len(b)
    center_c = sum(p[1] for p in b) // len(b)
    print(f"  center~({center_r}, {center_c})")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
